excerpts.author: pk910
excerpts.content:
it's the default image when setting a eip7732_fork_epoch in the network_params.
so you don't need to explicitly set it in your config.  But also don't set it to the master image or anything else 😉

this is my kt config (prysm image is probably outdated by now):
```
participants:
  - el_type: geth
    el_image: ethpandaops/geth:prague-devnet-6-c070db6
    cl_type: prysm
    cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:epbs
    vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:epbs
    count: 2
network_params:
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  eip7732_fork_epoch: 2
  min_validator_withdrawability_delay: 1
  shard_committee_period: 1
  churn_limit_quotient: 16
  seconds_per_slot: 6
#snooper_enabled: true
global_log_level: info
additional_services:
  - dora
```

you might need to add `--image-download always` to your `kurtosis run` command to avoid using outdated cached images.
